items.q: What is ArtCraft, on this tape?
items.a: Brandon Thomas rebuilt **seven Creative Cloud apps** in Rust with Claude and open-sourced them, including **Linux**, which Adobe has never officially supported. The trigger was repeated **cancellation fees**.

items.q: Why did FilmCraft fail the edit?
items.a: The UI is a near **one-to-one** of Premiere. Timeline playback **lagged** and the transitions were far below Premiere. He still pays Adobe **$69 a month**. DaVinci Resolve has been an alternative for **over 20 years**.

Run with **Node and npx**. **Ghidra** does the read-only analysis of native EXEs and DLLs and returns **C-like pseudocode**, assembly, strings, symbols, calls, and references. He points that at one Premiere timeline feature.
An agent rewrite, in **Rust**, of the features he actually uses. The Supabase sketch he calls **Studbase** comes from REA's network analysis. He says that **speed benchmark was made up**.
